svg.title: Waystone Mile — Milestone avenue
svg.desc: A procession of ancient waystones breaks the road into distinct clearings. Low plinths and a survey scaffold lead to a lookout above the repair route. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A procession of ancient waystones breaks the road into distinct clearings. Low plinths and
a survey scaffold lead to a lookout above the repair route.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Hillkeep Outskirts · P2 Fractured Highway · P3 Mosslion Refuge
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
